args.body: Dear Felix, an update on the oven at Flat 2, 176 Lantern Quay. Harbour Services say the oven is no longer under warranty. That is their claim and we are checking it: manufacturer warranties often run longer than 12 months, so I have asked them for the install date and the warranty terms. I also need to correct my earlier email, which said the oven was replaced in March 2025. That date cannot be right, so we are confirming the real one. Your email named Keystone Works as the fitter, while our notes say Harbour Services; please tell us if that is wrong. A visit is pencilled for 22 May at 2:30pm but the provider's emails give a different date, so it is not confirmed yet. No chargeable work will go ahead without your approval first. We will update you by 22 May. Kind regards
